lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Low-contrast vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the centroid of the circular clusters, creating a grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as three horizontal linear features on the upper-lateral flank, defined by a high-frequency transition from high luminance on the superior edge to low luminance on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance linear feature intersects the distal region of the right pectoral fin transversely. Several smaller, irregular high-luminance patches are visible on the anterior-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance fusiform silhouettes positioned ventrally to the main body mass.
